batch: 2026-11-17 网上接单的卖家（俊宇：再找 10 个做电商、还没网站的商家）
source: 查了 SAYS（2024-05、2024-11、2025-11）、Tatler Asia（2023-08、2025-03）、TheSmartLocal 的名单，只放写明电话的。每家都跑过 check-domains.sh，也搜过有没有自己的网店 / 点餐网站。排除（有自己的网店或下单网站）：Candlenuts（candlenuts.easy.co）、Pawsitive Kin、Sad Studio、HYGR、Le Wine、Kayla Batik、YuBake、Huckleberry、Cake Jalan Tiung、Keju by Carmen、EM's Soft Chunky Cookies、Samthing Sweet；排除（查不到价钱、不合购买力）：Sambal Enak、Pick A Pickle、Chonks!、Grams & Ozs、supukupu；排除（查不到电话，号码只在 IG 简介）：Finders Keepers Collection、Doggology、Lin Lin Cake、Brie.lliant、Crunchieco、Haloo Leather、Nom Nom Pet Store、Lemon & Butterflies。 另外：Make Hay, Sunshine（Bandar Utama，Shopify 网店显示 Store unavailable）只有座机 03-7733 2332、查不到 IG，不合工作台「IG 或手机至少一个」，没放。

leads.name: It's Baked By Suli
leads.contact_source: SAYS 2025-11 节日礼物名单写的 WhatsApp 60163337290；SAYS 2024-11 圣诞名单的 WhatsApp 连结也是同一个号码
leads.address: 在家做 · 地点没公开（送货）
leads.why: 网上接单的家庭烘焙（芝士蛋糕卷、蛋糕、饼干、节日套餐），只用 WhatsApp / IG 下单、要提早 3 天订，没有网站；SAYS 两年内 3 次推荐，蛋糕 RM60–170。
leads.verify: 打电话先确认还在接单、在哪一区；问一个月大概几张单、节日（圣诞、新年）是不是最忙。
leads.input:
What they sell: It's Baked By Suli, a home bakery selling online: Apple Crumble Cheesecake Log (500g RM60, 1kg RM110), Banana Chocolate Walnut Loaf with Caramel (RM18-46, 3-for bundles), cookie packs, gingerbread men (RM20) and gingerbread house (RM40) for Christmas (SAYS, Nov 2024); rose and daisy cakes RM150-170 for Mother's Day (SAYS, May 2024); cheesecakes, chewy / ginger / chocolate cookies and fruit crumbles, three days' notice, menu through December (SAYS, 21 Nov 2025).
Channels: WhatsApp 60163337290 and Instagram @itsbakedbysuli, Facebook ItsBakedbysuli. No website listed in any of the three articles.
Website check (2026-11-17): check-domains.sh itsbakedbysuli -> NONE; searched the name with 'order' -> no take.app / Beep / StoreHub / own shop found.
Observation: SAYS lists them in its Christmas treats guide two years running (2024 and 2025) and in a Mother's Day cakes guide (2024).
Angle: festive pre-orders (Christmas, CNY, Raya) with a cut-off date, bundles (3-for loaves) and pick-up / delivery slots, instead of collecting orders one by one in WhatsApp.
Sources: https://says.com/my/lifestyle/eats/festive-treats-and-christmas-goodies-this-2025 ; https://says.com/my/makan/christmas-desserts-to-get-this-2024 ; https://says.com/my/makan/unique-mothers-day-cakes

leads.name: The Pure Joie
leads.contact_source: SAYS 2024-05 母亲节蛋糕名单里的 WhatsApp 连结（wa.link 打开是 60162486666）
leads.address: 在家做 · 地点没公开
leads.why: 网上接单的蛋糕（Tropical Carrot Bundt Cake RM130），只用 WhatsApp / IG 下单，没有网站；缺：最近 2 年的报道（SAYS 2024-05）。
leads.verify: 号码来自 2024 年 5 月的文章：打电话先确认号码和还在做；purejoie.com 有防护页打不开，看起来不是他们的，问一下有没有自己的网站。
leads.input:
What they sell: The Pure Joie, cakes ordered online; SAYS featured their Tropical Carrot Bundt Cake at RM130 in its Mother's Day cakes guide (3 May 2024).
Channels: Instagram @thepurejoie, WhatsApp link in the article (wa.link/4cwzwq -> 60162486666). No website listed.
Website check (2026-11-17): check-domains.sh thepurejoie -> NONE; purejoie -> CHECK (Cloudflare challenge page, probably an unrelated site). No online shop found.
Observation: SAYS (May 2024) listed them next to bakeries that already have web shops (Lacher, Voila, Foret Blanc, Dusun).
Angle: a simple cake menu with sizes, pick-up / delivery date and online payment, for occasions (Mother's Day, birthdays, festive).
Sources: https://says.com/my/makan/unique-mothers-day-cakes

leads.name: Guilty Platters
leads.contact_source: Tatler Asia 拼盘指南（2023-08 更新）写的电话 +60 14-649 1512；Instagram @guiltyplatters 见 Zafigo 2022 名单
leads.address: 网上接单 · 地点没公开
leads.why: 网上接单的冷盘 / 芝士拼盘和派对 grazing table、节日（圣诞、情人节）套餐，没有网站；缺：最近 2 年的报道（Tatler 2023），价钱没公开。
leads.verify: 号码来自 2023 年的文章：先确认还在做；问拼盘大概价钱（派对拼盘通常 RM100 以上）和一个月几单；公司 / 活动订单多不多。
leads.input:
What they sell: Guilty Platters, rustic boxes of cold cuts, fruit and cheese, cheese platters for parties and grazing tables, with festive specials such as Christmas and Valentine's Day platters (Tatler Asia, 'The ultimate guide to artisan grazing platters', updated 22 Aug 2023). Prices are not published.
Channels: phone +60 14-649 1512 (Tatler), Instagram @guiltyplatters and Facebook (Zafigo 2022 list). No website.
Website check (2026-11-17): check-domains.sh guiltyplatters guiltyplattersmy -> NONE. No online shop found in searches.
Angle: platter menu with sizes and add-ons, date / time slot, deposit for grazing tables, festive pre-orders and corporate orders.
Sources: https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/the-ultimate-guide-to-artisan-grazing-platters ; https://zafigo.com/travel/zafigo-stories/20220310-best-cheese-grazing-platters-malaysia/

leads.name: Splatter
leads.contact_source: Tatler Asia 拼盘指南（2023-08 更新）写的电话 +6016 603 9674
leads.address: Tropicana, 47410 Petaling Jaya（Tatler 2023）；Klook 写的是 Damansara Perdana
leads.why: 水果 / 芝士拼盘、本地 kuih 拼盘和活动 grazing table，靠电话和 Klook 接单，没有自己的网站；缺：最近 2 年的报道（Tatler 2023）。
leads.verify: 先确认地点（Tropicana 还是 Damansara Perdana）和还在做；splatter.co 有防护页打不开，看起来不是他们的，问一下；IG 没查到，电话里问。
leads.input:
What they sell: Splatter, fruit and cheese platters, a locally inspired kuih platter, and grazing tables set up for events (Tatler Asia, updated 22 Aug 2023). Also listed on Klook as a delivery product ('[Delivery] SPLATTER in Petaling Jaya', branch Damansara Perdana, 4.7/5, 100+ booked).
Channels: phone +6016 603 9674 (Tatler), Klook listing. No own website found.
Website check (2026-11-17): check-domains.sh splattermy splatterplatters -> NONE; splatter.com -> PARKED; splatter.co -> CHECK (Cloudflare challenge, probably unrelated). Klook is a marketplace, not their own shop.
Angle: their own order page (no marketplace commission) with platter sizes, kuih platter for festive / office events, deposit for grazing tables.
Sources: https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/the-ultimate-guide-to-artisan-grazing-platters ; https://www.klook.com/activity/39632-splatter-petaling-jaya/

leads.name: The Gooey Cookies
leads.contact_source: Tatler Asia 2025-03 饼干名单和 TheSmartLocal 名单都写 013-339 4566
leads.address: UG26, Radia Retail, Persiaran Arked, Bukit Jelutong, 40150 Shah Alam
leads.why: Bukit Jelutong 的纽约式爆浆饼干店（Tue–Sun 12pm–8pm），2025 年 Tatler 推荐，有实体店；订单靠电话 / IG / Facebook，没有网站或网上点餐。
leads.verify: 确认还开、谁管订单；问饼干盒、节日礼盒（Raya、圣诞）和公司订单多不多；问外地客人要不要寄。
leads.input:
What they sell: The Gooey Cookies, New York-style cookies with a gooey, pudding-like centre, NYC-size and mini sizes (e.g. matcha), Trial Mini Gooey Box of four mini cookies RM13.90, plus drinks (Tatler Asia, 14 Mar 2025). Shop: UG26, Radia Retail, Persiaran Arked, Bukit Jelutong, 40150 Shah Alam; Tue-Sun 12pm-8pm, closed Mondays (TheSmartLocal).
Channels: phone +6013 339 4566, Instagram @thegooeycookies, Facebook. No website or online ordering found.
Website check (2026-11-17): check-domains.sh thegooeycookies thegooeycookiesmy -> NONE; gooeycookies.co -> EXPIRED (Squarespace, not confirmed theirs). Searched 'The Gooey Cookies Bukit Jelutong order': only phone / social media.
Observation: Tatler Asia (Mar 2025) put them in its 'best thick, chunky, gooey cookies' list next to mall chains (Chonky Cookies, Ben's Cookies).
Angle: cookie boxes and festive gift boxes ordered online with pick-up time or Klang Valley delivery, corporate gifting orders.
Sources: https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/best-thick-chunky-gooey-cookies ; https://thesmartlocal.my/cookie-shops-kl-selangor/
